query_translation_rule: Patterns are preregistered literals derived from request terminology and public contract names. They must not be changed after any formal observation is collected; changes require a new protocol version.
ranking_rule: One result per canonical file, ordered by ripgrep JSON match emission; first match binds the live-read line and file hash.
negative_case_rule: Cases with expected_result_mode=no_relevant are excluded from positive recall, precision and MRR populations and scored only by no_relevant_result_accuracy.

exclusion_rules: Exclude every case_id, query, expected relevant file set and exact search pattern from arm_a_repo_smoke_v3.
Exclude generated_mods, virtual environments, caches, data/evaluation/runs and prior observations from the canonical search corpus.
Do not remove a case after result collection; invalid cases remain reported with a preregistered exclusion reason.
Do not change judgments, patterns, top_k, thresholds or mutation expectations after result collection; create a new version instead.
stopping_rules: Stop and invalidate the run if repository, worktree, corpus, dataset, policy or protocol identity changes during collection.
Stop if any returned file fails final live rehash.
Stop if ripgrep identity, argv, normalized environment or command traces are absent.
Stop any indexed arm if stale or non-authoritative evidence reaches readiness, proposal or review.
Do not emit H1-H5 verdicts from Arm A alone.
